h1: ♂ Mars in Astrology: Drive • Boundaries • Courage
subtitle: Domicile: Aries , Scorpio • Exaltation: Capricorn
summary: Mars in astrology governs drive, action, ambition, sexuality, and how we assert ourselves and handle conflict. Its sign, house, and aspects in your chart reveal your style of pursuing goals—from decisive and direct to strategic or volatile—and where you expend physical energy. Mars rules Aries and traditional Scorpio, is exalted in Capricorn, in detriment in Libra and Taurus, and in fall in Cancer, shaping how confidently its qualities express. Through transits and retrogrades, Mars times periods of initiative, confrontation, and recalibration of motivation, boundaries, and courage.

sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Mars is your go-button. It decides when to act, how hard to push, and what to defend. Fed well, Mars is clean power. Starved, it leaks as snark, stalls, or scorched earth.

✅ What it wants

  • A clear target and a timebox
  • Permission to say “no” early
  • Direct feedback, not hints

⚠️ When it struggles

  • Procrastination disguised as “research”
  • Passive aggression; hot/cold cycles
  • Picking fights to feel alive

🧭 Feed it well

  • One priority per day; ship before noon
  • Move your body; sweat clears static
  • Say the boundary once, then act

sections.heading: Mars by Sign (how you push)
sections.html:
Aries — fast strikes, honest heat

Taurus — slow build, unstoppable once moving

Gemini — quick pivots, debate as sport

Cancer — protective, indirect, tenacious

Leo — proud effort, visible courage

Virgo — precise, service-first execution

Libra — assertive grace, fight fair

Scorpio — focused, strategic, all-in

Sagittarius — bold aims, long-range sprints

Capricorn — disciplined, results over noise

Aquarius — principled pushes, team-first

Pisces — wave attacks, compassion with teeth

sections.heading: Mars by House (where effort lands)
sections.html:
1st — visible drive; you go first

2nd — earnings via grit; fight for value

3rd — sharp words; energized learning/travel

4th — home projects; protect your base

5th — sport, romance chase, creative risk

6th — training, SOPs, tough service (Mars’s joy)

7th — conflict styles in partnership; boundaries

8th — strategy, shared resources, deep repair

9th — bold beliefs, publishing sprints

10th — career pushes, hard calls in public

11th — team drives, cause-based action

12th — quiet battles; rehab and retreat

sections.heading: Retrogrades & Cycle (pace and pressure)
sections.html:
Retrograde rhythm

  • Every ~26 months, ~8–10 weeks
  • Reassess goals, rehab strength, fix process drift
  • Watch hard contacts (e.g., Mars square Saturn)

House focus

  • Track the house Mars works through
  • Plan sprints under Mars in your 10th; train under the 6th
  • Blend sign tone for style and pace

Synastry hints

  • Your Mars ↔ their Venus = chemistry
  • Your Mars ↔ their Saturn = brakes/standards
  • See full compatibility for nuance

sections.heading: Quick Practice (work with your Mars)

  • Anger hygiene: breathe, name, act once
